draft.subject: Re: API pagination — and that walkthrough
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Glad things are going well, and happy to take you up on that walkthrough whenever you're ready.

On your open ticket about pagination: list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you won't need to fetch everything at once. Worth noting too that API rate limits scale with plan tier, with Pro and Team getting higher limits than Starter.

If it's useful, I can hold a short call this week to walk through your first project and tasks alongside the API side — just tell me a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Nadia
